MTLCompilerService_sandbox_denials.qualification: Log entry counts, including duplicate-report messages; not unique failed builds.

processor_power.qualification: Three one-second loaded samples concurrent with audit; not an idle baseline or calibrated power measurement. Both displays reported asleep, with no flip-count progress between audit statuses; not a visible-UU performance control.

memory_storage.qualification: Read-only health snapshot; no RAM stress, filesystem repair or storage benchmark.

battery.qualification: EC/SMC-reported condition; cross-platform battery/adapter measurement not performed, no causal link to GPU hang established.
